beats.text: Five Stoic reminders for the moment you want to quit.
One. You have survived one hundred percent of your worst days so far. The record is perfect.
Two. The obstacle is the path — not a detour from it. This hard part is the work.
Three. You control the effort, never the outcome. So keep rowing, and leave the result alone.
Four. 'Hard' and 'impossible' are not the same word. Don't let the first pretend to be the second.
Five. The oak grows strong in contrary winds. Resistance isn't ruining you; it's building you.
The Stoic doesn't quit when it's hard. Hard was always the point. Take one more step.
